# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.5 Worker 3: Japan and Korea (oe_eaj_, Slot 92, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v115_japan_korea.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 92 entry: scheduler host scope, once a quarter. Only world-level state lives here; the countries
# of the theatre are checked by their own quarterly pulse (on_action/oe_eaj_pulse.txt).
oe_eaj_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eaj_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_eaj_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_eaj_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_eaj_pulse_count add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1592
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eaj_imjin_crisis_active }
			NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
			country_exists = c:KOR
			country_exists = c:JAP
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_eaj_imjin_crisis_active value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope: a protagonist's quarterly check.
oe_eaj_country_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_syn_cd }
			OR = {
				has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_arsenale_maritime_shipyards
				has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_imperial_kiln_lacquer_belt
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_syn_cd years = 15 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eaj_craft_synergy_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_rule_is_global_arcs_full_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ai_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ai_cd years = 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eaj_full_ai_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	oe_eaj_story_tick = yes
}

# Country scope: fires at most one story event whose condition holds.
oe_eaj_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1467
			oe_eaj_is_japan_actor = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev3_done }
			current_year >= 1543
			oe_eaj_is_japan_actor = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev5_done }
			current_year >= 1550
			oe_eaj_is_japan_actor = yes
			owns = location:kurita
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev6_done }
			oe_eaj_is_japan_actor = yes
			owns = location:nishisonogi
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1550
				has_advance = otm_nanban_trade
				has_global_variable = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev8_done }
			current_year >= 1375
			tag = KOR
			NOT = { has_variable = KOR_joseon_dynasty }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.8

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev10_done }
			current_year >= 1430
			tag = KOR
			OR = {
				owns = location:uiju
				owns = location:hamheung
				owns = location:gyeongseong
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev10_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev11_done }
			current_year >= 1590
			has_ports = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev11_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev13_done }
			current_year >= 1597
			tag = KOR
			has_global_variable = oe_eaj_imjin_crisis_active
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev13_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev14_done }
			current_year >= 1650
			has_global_variable = oe_eaj_imjin_crisis_active
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev14_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev1_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1400
			tag = JAP
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev4_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1530
			oe_eaj_is_japan_actor = yes
			owns = location:nima
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eaj_ev7_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1600
			oe_eaj_is_japan_actor = yes

# Any scope. The great war across the strait has begun (this worker is the only writer of the global variable).
oe_eaj_start_imjin_crisis = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eaj_imjin_crisis_active } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_eaj_imjin_crisis_active value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Japan's choice of course: 1 = closed country, 2 = red-seal ships.
oe_eaj_choose_sakoku = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_path value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eaj_sakoku_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
}
oe_eaj_choose_shuinsen = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_eaj_path value = 2 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eaj_shuinsen_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
}

# Dev panel: research this theatre's advances.
oe_eaj_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_eaj_adv_hunminjeongeum_metal_type } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_eaj_adv_hunminjeongeum_metal_type
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_eaj_adv_tanegashima_volley_fire } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_eaj_adv_tanegashima_volley_fire
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_eaj_adv_iwami_haifuki_silver } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_eaj_adv_iwami_haifuki_silver
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_eaj_adv_geobukseon_hakikjin } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_eaj_adv_geobukseon_hakikjin
	}
}

# Dev panel: run the slot entry and this country's quarterly check now.
oe_eaj_dev_force_tick = {
	oe_eaj_monthly = yes
	oe_eaj_country_tick = yes
}

# Dev panel: readout.
oe_eaj_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eaj.90
